mapper.select: SELECT p.* FROM fund_receipt_repay_cash_flow_lib p INNER JOIN (SELECT main_id AS id, MAX(version) AS version FROM common_version t1 WHERE t1.module = 'FUND_RECEIPT_REPAY' AND t1.version_type = 1 GROUP BY main_id) m ON p.receipt_repay_id = m.id AND p.version = m.version WHERE p.repay_date >= #{repayDateFrom} AND p.repay_date <= #{repayDateTo}
